rationale: The final exploratory cycle raised the GP maximum sharply from 8.48 to 9.65 while reducing median uncertainty and adding 20 scaffolds. With three batches left, that recovered predictive signal justifies a substantial, but not exclusive, shift to exploitation.
expected_outcome: The 12 exploit candidates should include compounds approaching the 10.254 incumbent; the other 18 should add at least 11 scaffolds and guard against overconcentration.
